text: 中国央行明日开展证券、基金、保险公司互换便利操作，申报额度超1000亿元。 1150亿美元豪购Lumentum！Marvell打通“芯片+光学”，剑指AI互联超级帝国。 Lumentum Q1营收同比飙升136%，斩获50亿美元订单承诺，Q2指引大幅超预期。 AI信仰迎来新考验，股价暴跌后Alphabet赴欧债市场融资。 Anthropic美国IPO锁定日本市场，目标募资35亿美元。 甲骨文美股盘前跌超3%，公司寻求通过发行美元债券筹集100亿美元；拟发行100亿美元普通股。 报道：美方推动俄气经乌克兰管道恢复对欧销售，拟促成俄乌能源停火。 日经225指
text_en: The People's Bank of China will conduct Securities, Fund and Insurance Companies Swap Facility operations tomorrow, with declared amounts exceeding 100 billion yuan. Marvell's $115 billion blockbuster acquisition of Lumentum! Marvell connects "chips + optics," aiming at an AI interconnect super-empire. Lumentum Q1 revenue surged 136% year on year, secured $5 billion in order commitments, and its Q2 guidance substantially beat expectations. AI faith faces a new test as Alphabet turns to the European debt market for financing after a stock plunge. Anthropic's US IPO targets the Japanese market, aiming to raise $3.5 billion. Oracle falls over 3% in US premarket trading; the company seeks to raise $10 billion through a dollar bond issuance and plans to issue $10 billion of common stock. Report: The US side is pushing for Gazprom to resume sales to Europe via the Ukraine pipeline and plans to broker a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire. Nikkei 225 index
